title_cyr: Мила мајко што ме роди толку сиромав
title_latin: Mila majko što me rodi tolku siromav
title_en: Dear mother why did you give birth to me so poor

lines.cyr: Леле мајко што ме роди толку сиромав?
lines.lat: Lele majko što me rodi tolku siromav?
lines.en: Dear mother why did you give birth to me so poor?
Poor, poor, so damn poor (I have become wasted).

lines.cyr: Куќа имам, жена немам, леле сиромав.
lines.lat: Kuḱa imam, žena nemam, lele siromav.
lines.en: I have a house, but I have no wife.
Poor, poor, so damn poor (I have become wasted).

lines.cyr: Кревет имам, јорган немам, леле сиромав.
lines.lat: Krevet imam, jorgan nemam, lele siromav.
lines.en: I have a bed, but I have no blanket.
Poor, poor, so damn poor (I have become wasted).

lines.cyr: Ќумбе имам, дрва немам, леле сиромав.
lines.lat: Ḱumbe imam, drva nemam, lele siromav.
lines.en: I have a stove, but I have no wood (to burn in the stove).
Poor, poor, so damn poor (I have become wasted).

lines.cyr: Ќесе имам, пари немам, леле сиромав.
lines.lat: Ḱese imam, pari nemam, lele siromav.
lines.en: I have a wallet, but I have no money.
Poor, poor, so damn poor (I have become wasted).
